description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to circular state testing in Orleans grains, including serializable state classes with circular references.

classes.name: CircularStateTestState
classes.description: Serializable class representing the state with a CircularTest1 property.

classes.name: CircularTest1
classes.description: Serializable class containing a CircularTest2 property, forming part of a circular reference.

classes.name: CircularTest2
classes.description: Serializable class containing a list of CircularTest1 objects, completing the circular reference.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Asynchronous method to retrieve the current state of the grain.
